title: Very difficult
text: Very difficult. The bin needs to be shut LAST! This worked beautifully for almost two years, THEN I made the mistake of CLOSING THE BIN FIRST. Now the red release button on top stuck and I can’t empty the bin. SO, I went out to the garage and got out my old DC44 which has a red release button on the side (much better design) to release the bin so I can empty it! I cleaned everything and VOILA! The V7 is sitting in my car waiting for me to take it in to the shop—maybe they have some magic. I sure don’t. Before you buy this I suggest putting a sign up on the wall to close the bin last, otherwise you’ll have a problem.
